dedupe_keys.name: plan4res results for man0euvre case study 8 based on envis60 necp essentials v1 3 scenario for 2030

description: This dataset contains plan4res simulation results for Man0EUvRE Case Study 8 using the ENVIS60 NECP Essentials version 1.3 scenario for 2030. It includes installed electricity capacities, variable costs, annual generation by technology, marginal costs and non-served electricity. Results are supplied both as averages over uncertainties and with scenario, season or representative-week aggregations. The deposit is a defined scenario-output bundle for electricity-system planning. The related FanSi record describes separate price experiments for the project’s 2050 Case Study 2. The source cites the scenario parameterisation and a case-study deliverable as supporting material, without asserting that those publications are this dataset. Sandrine Charousset Brignol of EDF deposited seven XLSX workbooks, available free from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. Units and geographical aggregation remain unknown in the inspected metadata. No empirical validation or successful rerun is established.
